Updated Brenton English Septuagint, eBible.org, https://ebible.org/englxxup/

The edition's own statement of rights (from eBible.org's page for this translation, https://ebible.org/englxxup/copyright.htm):
> Spelling and formatting update of the Brenton English Septuagint with Apocrypha
> Public Domain
> Language: English
> Dialect: Mixed
> Translation by: Sir Lancelot C. L. Brenton
> Contributor: Adam Boyd
> Original work was by Sir Lancelot C. L. Brenton in 1851.
> CC0 Public Domain dedication on language updates by Adam Boyd in 2020.
> 2026-02-18

What was found:
Text: Brenton's Septuagint (Brenton died 1862) with language updates by Robert Adam Boyd (living), 2020.

Why it is admitted: Admitted as an exception on the maintainer's decision alone (2026-10-21): the only public-domain statement for Robert Adam Boyd's changes is eBible.org's label, and eBible.org is not Boyd's project; the same exception covers his three editions on eBible.org (engasvbt, englxxup, grctr).

The verse-per-line archive holds the Bible text in one file, one verse per line, each line starting with its reference (book, chapter:verse); its SQL and XML copies of the same text, eBible.org's description page, style sheet and signature are left out of the source.

Sources of these facts: eBible.org's details page (https://ebible.org/details.php?id=englxxup), the edition's copyright page (https://ebible.org/englxxup/copyright.htm), https://ebible.org/details.php?id=englxxup.

note: The verse-numbered twin of ebible-englxxup-6a809069, for the parallel verses measure only (#35): its tag is verse-numbers alone, which no mixture selects, so it never enters training.
